name: Population
overview: Scripture reveals that God intentionally created humanity to multiply and fill the earth, granting dominion over all living creatures as part of His design (Genesis 1:28). The careful counting of the people of Israel underscores the value and order God places on His creation (Numbers 1:2). Moreover, the inherent worth of each person is emphasized, being more precious than gold (Isaiah 13:12), and all things, including humanity, were created by and for Christ, who sustains all creation (Colossians 1:16). This teaches that population is not merely a number but a reflection of God's purposeful and sovereign plan.
